core.title: Kestrel kickoff rule restated
core.setting: The office manager at Kestrel Accountants, a six-person firm, whose assistant handles client onboarding and deadline calendars

events.text: Standing practice for onboarding: every new-client kickoff session is booked in Meeting Room 2, starts no earlier than 10:00, and any kickoff booking longer than two hours needs Martin's sign-off before it goes in the calendar.
Once a kickoff date has been confirmed with a client, we do not move or reschedule it without that client's written consent. If a client needs a change, ask them first and wait for their agreement.
We've signed the engagement letter for Harbor Logistics. We're 14 staff and would like the onboarding kickoff in the first half of July. Jonah Beck is your contact.
Room notes: Meeting Room 2 seats 8 and has the big screen for presentations; Room 1 only seats 4 and has no screen.

Booked the Harbor Logistics onboarding kickoff for Thursday 9 July, 10:00 to 12:00 in Meeting Room 2. That's a two-hour slot at the earliest allowed start, so no extra sign-off is needed, and the room seats the whole team with the screen for the presentation.
Reminder: quarterly payroll filings for our employer clients fall due on 7 August 2026.
Put a payroll filing prep block in the calendar for Monday 3 August, 09:00 to 12:00 in Room 1, so the filings due on the 7th are ready ahead of time.
Bright Nursery is on board. The only date our people can all make is 21 July, and because we're covering payroll and VAT in one go we'd need a good three hours. Tessa Grant is your contact.
Spoke with Martin about the long Bright Nursery session: he's happy for a kickoff longer than two hours on the 21st, so we can book it.

Booked the Bright Nursery onboarding kickoff for Tuesday 21 July, 10:00 to 13:00 in Meeting Room 2, confirmed with Tessa Grant. It's a three-hour session, which runs past the two-hour line, so Martin approved it before it went in.
Opened the onboarding tracker for Harbor Logistics, assigned to Nell as the junior in charge of the checklist, 12 steps, status active.
Stationery order arrived, we're stocked on envelopes and letterheads for a while.
VAT returns for two quarterly clients are due by 31 August 2026.
Blocked out Monday 31 August, 09:00 to 13:00 in Room 1, for the VAT returns due that day.
Bramble Print quote: printed welcome folders for new clients at 2.40 each, any quantity over 25.
Ordered 50 welcome folders from Bramble Print at the quoted 2.40 each for the onboarding packs.
Invoice from Bramble Print for 50 welcome folders, 120.00 total, payment terms 30 days.
The kickoff went well. Could we do a first review session in late September, morning, with the same setup as last time?
Opened the onboarding tracker for Bright Nursery, assigned to Nell, 12 steps, status active.
To do: pay the Bramble Print folder invoice of 120.00 by 20 August.
Bramble Print invoice paid on 14 August, all settled.
Booked the Harbor Logistics first review session for Friday 25 September, 10:00 to 11:30 in Meeting Room 2, same room and morning slot as their kickoff, confirmed with Jonah Beck.
From now on every onboarding pack should include the new confidentiality leaflet alongside the welcome folder.
Team minutes: payroll filings all submitted on time; Nell to keep both client trackers moving; nothing else raised.
Quick note that we're happy with how the onboarding is going, no changes needed on our side.

Priya, just to confirm our onboarding practice in writing so there's no doubt: all new-client kickoff sessions are held in Meeting Room 2, they can't start before 10:00, and any kickoff running over two hours needs my approval before it's booked. Same as it's always been.
Calendar notice: Harbor Logistics review session on 25 September, Meeting Room 2, 10:00 to 11:30, confirmed with the client.

Fernwood Dental has signed the engagement letter. For the onboarding kickoff we could do Tuesday 29 September or Thursday 1 October, and we'd need around two hours. Five of us would attend. Ravi Shah is your contact.
Idea for future kickoffs: what if we tried 90-minute sessions instead, so Meeting Room 2 frees up earlier in the day? Just a thought for when we're planning.
If possible we'd prefer the 29 September date for the kickoff, we're all free that morning.
To do: chase Jonah Beck for review session agenda items by 22 September.
